title: THE NVIDIA AI GPU BLACK MARKET | Investigating Smuggling, Corruption, & Governments
summary: A Gamers Nexus investigative documentary on the black market for Nvidia AI GPUs, following smugglers, middlemen, and buyers, including reporting from China. It examines how export-restricted chips reach their users.
why: HN recommends it as real on-the-ground reporting on how banned GPUs get into China despite export controls.

quote.text: Gamers Nexus has a good video where his team travelled to China and did some actual investigative journalism
